slots.notes: Full-bleed background video behind the dashboard screenshot; absolutely positioned inset-0, w-full h-full object-cover, in a w-screen 16:9 band. Muted ambient loop.
Product/dashboard screenshot composited over the hero video with mixBlendMode 'luminosity' and a parallax y:0->-250; max-w-5xl w-[90%] rounded-2xl. Wide landscape app shot.
Small navbar logo icon sitting left of the 'Neuralyn' wordmark on a pure-black bg; needs transparency.
Decorative opening quotation-mark glyph above the testimonial (w-14 h-10 object-contain) on black; needs transparency.
Circular author headshot in the testimonial author row; rendered w-14 h-14 rounded-full with a 3px white border, object-cover.
Body/UI typeface served via @fontsource/inter at weights 400/500/600/700; fills the 'body' font role.
Italic display accent typeface served via @fontsource/instrument-serif (400 + 400-italic); used only for the italic accent word 'Overview' in the headline; fills the 'accent'/'display' font role.

mechanic: Framer Motion useScroll parallax over a tall sticky hero — hero copy rises and fades (y:0->-200, opacity 1->0) while a luminosity-blended dashboard screenshot drifts (y:0->-250) above a looping full-bleed video, then a second section scroll-reveals a testimonial word by word from grey to white.
techDelivery: React + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion + shadcn/ui, with @fontsource font packages and HSL CSS custom properties in :root.
reskinNotes: Theme colors are clean HSL CSS variables, but the testimonial word-reveal hardcodes its grey->white interpolation as literal 'hsl(0 0% 35%)'->'hsl(0 0% 100%)' inside a Framer Motion useTransform (not the --foreground token), and the liquid-glass pill bakes white rgba stops (0.45/0.15/0.1) directly into CSS — so a non-monochrome brand must edit both the JS motion values and the .liquid-glass gradient. All copy is hardcoded in JSX, and the Instrument Serif italic styling is welded to a single word inside the headline, so headline-line2 is split into a plain run plus the styled accent word ('Overview'). The hero subtitle color uses a separate --hero-subtitle variable (210 17% 95%) distinct from --foreground.
